scene.title: Worth checking
scene.question: Does a persistent concern produce an understandable check?

alerts.evidence: suction pressure 4.86 kPa below the value expected for this operating point (z=-4.4). Context: demand 52 %, supply water 14.3 degC.
alerts.recommended_action: Inspect and clean (backflush) the suction strainer at the next opportunity; check the suction-side valves are fully open.
